title: Short Recurrences and Straight-Line Programs for Primes
summary: We give a short autonomous recurrence that generates every odd prime, in increasing order, from the single initial value $8$. Its integer state determines both its output and its next update: the lowest set bit gives the next prime, while the highest set bit determines the sieve period. The same state also determines the following prime gap. A related recurrence represents the prime-counting function as the $2$-adic valuation of a single integer. Independently, a direct packing of a finite divisor sieve yields fixed arithmetic constructions for the $n$-th prime, the prime-counting function,…
